mp.title: Multiplayer
mp.subtitle: Universal virtual LAN networking tool
mp.source.line: This section's UI and settings are ported from the MCTier project (original author: MCTier Team, original project: https://github.com/pmh1314520/MCTier). MCTier's own code uses a custom source-available non-commercial license, which is incompatible with this launcher's open source license; therefore the origin is labeled separately and the original author information is preserved.
mp.help.title: How to play together
mp.help.subtitle: Everything runs inside this launcher — no separate MCTier install needed
mp.help.step1.title: Create or join a lobby
mp.help.step1.body: On the Multiplayer home screen, click "Create Lobby" and enter a name and password (8-32 characters with letters and digits). To join someone, use the exact same name and password with "Join Lobby".
mp.help.step2.title: Wait for a virtual IP
mp.help.step2.body: The launcher drives its bundled EasyTier core to connect to the node; a 10.126.126.x virtual IP is normally assigned within 2-3 seconds. It uses no-TUN mode, so no administrator rights are needed and system network settings are untouched.
mp.help.step3.title: Host opens the world to LAN
mp.help.step3.body: The host enters a single-player Minecraft world, presses Esc → "Open to LAN", and notes the port shown in chat (usually 25565 or a random port).
mp.help.step4.title: Others connect directly
mp.help.step4.body: Others use "Multiplayer → Direct Connect" and enter "host virtual IP:port", e.g. 10.126.126.1:25565. The lobby home screen can copy this address with one click.
mp.help.note.title: Notes
mp.help.note.body: Everyone must use the same EasyTier node (customizable in "Settings → Private Server"). If you never receive a virtual IP, try another node; the lobby name and password must match exactly for everyone.
mp.notice.title: About this feature
mp.notice.body: Multiplayer is fully self-contained: an EasyTier core ships with the launcher, so no separate MCTier client needs to be installed or running. Creating or joining a lobby really connects to peer nodes and obtains a virtual IP via DHCP; no-TUN mode means no administrator rights are needed and system network settings are untouched.

mp.set.title: Multiplayer Settings
mp.set.subtitle: These settings are ported from MCTier's app settings and are saved to the launcher config.
mp.set.card.playerDesc: The name and avatar shown in a lobby; defaults to the current launcher account.
mp.set.playerNameDesc: The name others see after you join a lobby
mp.set.playerNameSyncDesc: Use the current account name as the multiplayer player name
mp.set.card.appDesc: App behavior for multiplayer (currently managed by the launcher itself; the items below are informational).
mp.set.autoStartupDesc: Run the launcher automatically when the system starts
mp.set.alwaysOnTopDesc: Keep the window always in front
mp.set.rememberPosDesc: Restore the last window position on startup
mp.set.closeToTrayDesc: Hide to the system tray and keep running instead of quitting
mp.set.startMinimizedDesc: Hide to the system tray after launch and run silently
mp.set.gpuDesc: Disabling reduces GPU usage but turns off some animations
mp.set.card.autoLobbyDesc: Automatically enter a specific lobby when the launcher starts.
mp.set.autoLobbyDesc: Automatically enter the lobby configured below after launch
mp.set.autoLobbyNote: Note: auto lobby uses the same server as manual lobby creation. If "Use private server" is enabled, it uses the EasyTier and signaling servers configured below; otherwise it uses the default selectable node.
mp.set.card.privateDesc: The MCTier website provides backend source code and self-hosting tutorials so you can run your own server.
mp.set.usePrivateDesc: Enable to configure your own deployed server
mp.set.privateNote: Note: the MCTier website only provides the signaling server source code.
mp.set.card.nodesDesc: Add backup nodes to pick from when creating/joining a lobby.
mp.set.nodeErrAddress: Invalid node address; it must start with tcp://, udp://, ws://, wss:// or txt://
mp.set.nodeErrDup: This node address already exists, do not add it again
mp.set.nodeDeleteConfirm: Delete node "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
mp.set.nodeBuiltinLocked: Default fallback nodes cannot be deleted
mp.set.card.hotkeysDesc: Click a field and press your desired key combination to record it. Changes take effect immediately without restarting. Leave empty to disable a hotkey.
mp.set.hotkeyMicDesc: Turn your microphone on or off
mp.set.hotkeyMuteDesc: Mute or unmute everyone at once
mp.set.hotkeyPTTDesc: Mic opens while held, restores when released
mp.set.hotkeySummonDesc: Bring the window back to front from tray or minimized state
mp.set.hotkeyErrDup: Hotkey {key} is already used by "{name}", please choose another
mp.set.card.soundDesc: Adjust the alert volume and set Do Not Disturb hours.
mp.set.dndDesc: When enabled, no sounds play during the hours below
mp.set.card.danmakuDesc: When enabled, chat messages float across the top of the screen so you never miss them while gaming; adjust size, speed, opacity and tracks.
mp.set.danmakuEnabledDesc: Chat messages float across the top of the screen
mp.set.danmakuPreviewMsg: This is a danmaku preview message
mp.set.card.hudDesc: Show teammate latency and who is speaking in a screen corner while gaming.
mp.set.hudEnabledDesc: Show multiplayer status in a click-through always-on-top overlay
mp.set.card.voiceDesc: Choose the default voice used after joining a lobby; it applies as soon as you unmute.
mp.set.card.statsDesc: Purely local stats of multiplayer time and join/host counts; never reported online.
mp.set.card.toolsDesc: Direct-connect address generator and handy tools for quick play.
